description: A `kind = "claude"` seat with no `command` wrapper configured is refused by dispatch --dry-run before any card is printed — a pure config check (accounts.py candidates(), SkipCause.NO_COMMAND), identical whether or not --dry-run is given (tests/test_dispatch.py:133-183 pins the same check for a real dispatch). As the sole chain entry it exhausts the chain immediately with a message naming the exact config key to set.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.claude-personal]
kind = "claude"
config_dir_var = "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR"
config_dir = "{{DIR:claude-home}}"
pool = "claude:personal"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[projects.sandbox.chains]
explorer = ["claude-personal"]

[roles.explorer]
write_scope = "none"
effort = "low"
on_exhausted = "degrade"
skills = []

[roles.explorer.models]
claude = "claude-test"

stderr_contains: no command wrapper configured; set accounts.claude-personal.command to the Claude wrapper from docs/install.md
